descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S19 「看文档：留下的模板和原型 p72 一致，SNF consult/discharge 是新做的，保留窗口是配置值、用服务器时钟」 Doc review: surviving templates match prototype p72, SNF consult/discharge are built new, retention windows are config values on the server clock

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 SNF Consult and SNF Discharge are built new, confirmed not present in the current prototype, not a port（TFA-92599 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • T2 Content and formatting of each surviving template still match the prototype exactly (TFA-94229)（TFA-92599 AC 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U7j Retention windows are configuration values (not hard-coded), the clocks use server time, and the purge runs on the server（UAT TC-21 step 4；UAT 3.6；TFA-94699 AC 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Prototype RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html (TFA-94229), the app's templates, and convex/lib/lifecycle.ts plus the purge job

When Compare section headings and formatting of the 6 surviving templates; confirm SNF consult/discharge are not ports; read where the retention windows and the clock come from

Then The 6 survivors match exactly; 2 new SNF templates exist; every 3.6 window is a configuration value (not hard-coded), the clocks are server time, and the purge runs on the server

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Side-by-side review by a person. Facts to start from: on e02167f the windows are `as const` objects HOSPITAL_RETENTION / SNF_RETENTION in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts. Whether a source constant counts as the 'configuration value' 3.6 asks for (lengthened later under a hospital affiliation) is the reviewer's call. SNF consult/discharge are not built (known: TFA-92599 AC 2).

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S19 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-21.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；Allure 状态按分诊从 failed 改成 broken。

问题分类：票没到 ready for qa · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92599 in progress；TFA-94699 in progress

养老院没有 SNF Consult 和 SNF Discharge 模板（consult 住户默认用 follow-up 模板）；过期的病人数据只在医生开着 app 时才清，没人登录就一直留着。

Nursing Home has no SNF Consult or SNF Discharge note (a consult resident gets the follow-up template), and expired patient data is purged only while a physician has the app open, so it can stay stored past its window.

依据：allure-results/52dc0692… (code review). (a) There is no SNF Consult or SNF Discharge template, and a consult falls back to snf-progress: dev report §4 / U43, TFA-92599 AC 2 knownGap. (b) There is no purge cron (crons.ts has only the session sweep), so retention runs only when a client calls applyLifecycle. That is already recorded as OAT-04 K3 and TC-19 U14b under TFA-94699 AC 7. Whether the windows, which are source constants, count as 'config values' needs sign-off.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；辅助：CONFIG · 配置核对 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：code-review。

本地新 lane code-review：code-review/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 没写 productIssue，按它的 physicianImpact 算））。

Detail:

This is a fail. One failing point is decided now and is not in the matrix, and one recorded gap applies.

(a) Templates offered. The prompt library has 12 templates. The app shows only a fixed list for each context (apps/web/src/lib/templates.ts):
- Hospital: hp, soap, consult, discharge.
- SNF: snf-admission, snf-progress.

No SNF Consult or SNF Discharge template exists. The status mapping points a Consult to "snf-consult", which isn't offered, so it falls back to snf-progress. This is the recorded gap known:no-snf-consult-discharge-templates (TFA-92599 AC 2).

(b) Retention windows and the purge.
- **Windows:** they are `as const` source constants, HOSPITAL_RETENTION and SNF_RETENTION in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts. They are not environment or database configuration. Whether that counts as the "configuration value" 3.6 asks for is the reviewer's call (pending:signoff).
- **Clock:** both lifecycle mutations take the time from Date.now() on the Convex server, so the clock is server time.
- **Purge (new failing point):** there is no lifecycle or purge cron. convex/crons.ts registers only the hourly session sweep. The purge runs only when the client calls rounding.applyLifecycle or snf.applyLifecycle: from AppLayout's ContextLifecycle when a page opens, then every 10 minutes while it stays open. So the purge code runs on the server, but nothing on the server starts it. If no client opens the app, expired PHI stays stored.

The person's side-by-side of the 6 surviving templates against p72 was not judged here.

产品问题（按 physicianImpact）：lane 没写 productIssue，失败·产品按它的 physicianImpact 算（全文见下）。

等开放问题（pendingOn）：

  • signoff

新发现（newFindings）：

  • apps/web/convex/crons.ts:9: The only cron registered is the session sweep. No lifecycle or retention purge is scheduled on the server.
  • apps/web/convex/rounding.ts:128: The purge is a public mutation that the client calls. It works only on the calling user's patients, so it is not a server-scheduled job.
  • apps/web/src/components/layout/AppLayout.tsx:128: The client starts the lifecycle mutations from AppLayout when a page opens, and repeats every 10 minutes only while a page stays open.
  • apps/web/convex/crons.ts:9: No purge cron is registered; the only cron is the session sweep
  • apps/web/src/components/layout/AppLayout.tsx:128: The purge is triggered by the client: the browser calls applyLifecycle on mount and every 10 minutes with window.setInterval, so it runs only while a physician has the app open
  • apps/web/convex/rounding.ts:128: The lifecycle is a public mutation scoped to the calling user, reached from the client, not an internal scheduled function

确认的已知缺口（knownGapsConfirmed）：

  • apps/web/src/lib/templates.ts:30: The SNF context offers only the SNF admission and SNF progress templates. There is no SNF consult or SNF discharge template.
  • apps/web/src/lib/templates.ts:44: The status mapping names snf-consult, but that template is not built and the code says it falls back to Follow-up.
  • apps/web/src/lib/templates.ts:30: The SNF context offers only SNF Admission and SNF Follow-up; there is no SNF Consult or SNF Discharge template
  • apps/web/src/lib/templates.ts:55: The SNF consult status maps to 'snf-consult', which does not exist; templateForStatus falls back to the Follow-up template

开放问题（openQuestions）：

  • pending:signoff — does a source `as const` constant (HOSPITAL_RETENTION / SNF_RETENTION) count as the 'configuration value' 3.6 asks for? This is the reviewer's call.
  • The question's pass/fail rule asks only whether the purge 'runs on the server'. The mutation's code does run on Convex, but only a client starts it, and the question counts that as failing. The Then reads the same way. I treated the client-triggered purge as a new failing point; a person should confirm that reading.
  • pending:signoff — does a source constant (`as const` HOSPITAL_RETENTION / SNF_RETENTION) count as the configuration value 3.6 asks for?
  • Is a client-triggered purge (only while the app is open) an accepted 3.6 design, or is a server cron required? The oracle does not mention this; I treated it as a new failing point.

代码定不了（notDecidableByCode）：

  • 6 surviving templates vs p72 (a person's side-by-side (sign-off))
  • half:6 surviving templates vs p72 — whether the section headings and formatting of the 6 surviving templates match the prototype exactly needs a person's side-by-side review; it was not compared here.
  • Whether a purge cron is registered on the dev deployment (CONFIG, Tim) is outside this verdict.
  • half:6 surviving templates vs p72 — whether the section headings and formatting of the 6 surviving templates match prototype p72 exactly needs a person's side-by-side review; I did not compare them
  • Whether the purge cron is registered on dev (CONFIG, Tim) is outside this verdict

对医生的影响（physicianImpact）：A nursing-home physician cannot pick an SNF Consult or SNF Discharge note format; a consult resident gets the SNF progress template by default. Expired working data such as transcripts, notes and medications is cleared only when the physician opens the app. If nobody logs in, it stays stored past its retention window. / Expired patient working data (pre-round notes, transcripts, notes, done tasks) is cleared only while that physician has the app open. If they stop logging in, PHI stays past the 12–48h windows. In the nursing-home context there is no SNF Consult or SNF Discharge note, and a consult status quietly pre-selects SNF Follow-up instead.

审查结论（verdict）：fail

证据：附了 2 个。

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: outside-runner (manual: doc-review). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
